card.name: Job title nouns before organization names
card.fires_on: The last word of a job title or office name, such as Director, Manager, Member, Department or General, right before 'of' or an institution name. It appears in bylines, staff lists and news quotes.

modes.label: Title head noun
modes.description: Director, Manager or Member ends a role title and an organization or unit comes next.
modes.example: The Associate<< Director>>, Centre for Teaching and Learning is working

modes.label: Department or General
modes.description: The word Department or General completes a title such as Head of Press Department or Director General.
modes.example: Head of Fine Arts<< Department>> at Indus Valley

card.writes: It promotes a mix of unrelated abbreviations and Chinese words, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up on the last word of a job title, like Director or Manager, just before the organization is named.
